linked-view.instruction: You can edit the data, and see basic statistics and distribution.

correlation.instruction:
- Adjust the slider to change the strength and direction of correlation.
 - Add points by clicking on the chart to see how they affect the correlation. 
 - Watch how patterns shift and learn what correlation really looks like!

linear-regression.instruction:
- With Draw mode, you can click on scatter plot to add points, then show new regression lines that reflect new data.
 - With the Guess regression mode, you can draw a possible regression line on the scatter plot, and compare to actual results.

sampling-distribution.instruction:
- This interactive demo illustrates the Central Limit Throrem: Regardless of the population shape, the distribution of sample means tends to be normal as the number of samples increase.
 - Select a population shape, sample size and number of samples. Then click Simulate button to see how the distributon of sample means forms.
